in_marathi.name: Asaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Calm, Free from Sorrows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asaram means 'calm' or 'free from sorrows'. In Hindu mythology, Asaram is a name of Lord Rama and is associated with strength, wisdom, and compassion. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asrama', meaning 'hermitage' or 'place of retreat'.
